essence: A properly accomplished act yields its intended result effortlessly and certainly.
Mantra accomplishment brings both identification with the deity and mantra-success.
Obstacles disperse before the accomplished practitioner as elephants flee from a lion.
Without protective power, one is overwhelmed by obstacles like a fawn by tigers.
The mātṛkā can be engaged either through bead-supported construction or without mental construction.
